exam.scope: Prospective synthetic fixtures generated after the parent snapshot; historical diagnostics derived from pinned state and manifest, not asserted unseen in previous training. Same-owner public protocol, no external blinded examiner.
modes: same frozen model with JSON replaced by empty object
deterministic JSON parser and exact operations
exam.counterfactual: Each nonmissing synthetic task has a modified JSON with changed answer, same question and answer options; report paired both-correct.
exam.context: No truncation; all prompts plus max generation fit 128 byte token context.
exam.scoring: Exact answer, per group, paired wins/losses; forced-choice is not open-ended generation. No learning or tuning on this cohort. Compare pinned parent with baseline controls; future candidates must use genuinely new task cohorts for gain; disclosed baseline only regression.
